# Implementation Readiness Checklist: Core Planner (Slice 1)

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality, completeness, and architectural clarity prior to task breakdown and implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Architecture & Persistence Quality

- [x] CHK001 - Are database table schemas, column types, and foreign key cascades fully specified for all Slice 1 entities? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, Plan §2]
- [x] CHK002 - Are explicit SQL check constraints defined for scheduling integrity across Inbox, Day, Week, Month, and Year? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010-FR-014, Plan §2]
- [x] CHK003 - Is the completion integrity constraint (`not is_manually_completed or status = 'complete'`) explicitly specified? [Consistency, Spec §FR-028, Plan §2]
- [x] CHK004 - Is the in-memory tree projection strategy clearly defined for a single user-scoped query? [Clarity, Plan §1]
- [x] CHK005 - Are lazy initialization and fallback semantics documented for the `user_preferences` record without database triggers? [Completeness, Plan §9]

## Hierarchy & Domain Logic Rigor

- [x] CHK006 - Is recursive weighted progress calculation defined with deterministic formulas for leaf, parent, cancelled, and zero-weight scenarios? [Measurability, Spec §FR-021-FR-026]
- [x] CHK007 - Are context inheritance rules on child creation explicitly specified for Area and Day dates? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019-FR-020, Plan §4]
- [x] CHK008 - Is hierarchy cycle prevention defined with unambiguous validation rules before persistence? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §4]
- [x] CHK009 - Are all 7 weekdays specified as valid options for `first_day_of_week` with Monday default? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Plan §6]
- [x] CHK010 - Is sequential integer `sort_order` specified for sibling reordering without fractional or LexoRank complexity? [Clarity, Plan §7]

## Authentication & Security Boundaries

- [x] CHK011 - Is single-user authentication explicitly restricted to email/password with public registration disabled at the configuration level? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, Plan §3]
- [x] CHK012 - Are Row Level Security (RLS) policies defined for all tables using authenticated owner isolation? [Coverage, Plan §2]
- [x] CHK013 - Is server-side identity verification specified via `supabase.auth.getClaims()` for Server Actions without trusting client `user_id` input? [Clarity, Plan §1, Plan §3]
- [x] CHK014 - Is the developer owner provisioning workflow defined via `scripts/provision-owner.ts` without SQL insertion into `auth.users`? [Completeness, Plan §3, Quickstart §1]
- [x] CHK015 - Are key naming conventions aligned to `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` and server-only `SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY`? [Consistency, Plan §3]

## UX & Responsive Ergonomics

- [x] CHK016 - Are Quick Add target horizon and period defaults explicitly defined across Today, Inbox, Week, Month, Year, and child contexts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK017 - Is the 3-option parent completion resolution prompt explicitly specified with all state transitions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-027-FR-029]
- [x] CHK018 - Are multi-input same-list reorder interactions specified for desktop drag-and-drop, mobile touch, and keyboard navigation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-043, Plan §7]
- [x] CHK019 - Are single-Area filtering rules defined with contextual non-matching ancestor visibility? [Clarity, Spec §FR-034, Plan §8]
- [x] CHK020 - Are responsive application shell layouts defined for both desktop sidebar/drawer and mobile bottom nav/sheet? [Coverage, Spec §FR-043-FR-044, Plan §Source Layout]
- [x] CHK021 - Is the `/settings` route defined to cover both `first_day_of_week` and Area CRUD? [Completeness, Plan §9]

## Scope & Non-Goals Integrity

- [x] CHK022 - Are all future-slice capabilities (Move, auto-rollover, recurrence, reminders, templates, bulk actions, Realtime) strictly excluded from Slice 1? [Consistency, Spec §Boundaries, Plan §Slice 1 Boundaries]
- [x] CHK023 - Are testing boundaries prioritized for Vitest pure domain tests and focused Playwright user journeys without test bloat? [Measurability, Plan §11]
